review_identity.independence_statement: This review did not read RESEARCH_SYSTEM_AUDIT_v1_0.md, any dispute registry, changelog, prior agent conclusion, market data, adapter, backtest, or Library/Application Support artifact.

checks.evidence: CORE_TRADING_THEORY_v2_1.md:1237-1246 defines the current q geometry with worst cost and tail per unit, while RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:570-581 independently defines PositionSize without those terms and with untyped caps.

The object dictionary gives domains and units for all listed variables, but RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:206-238 leaves ER and RVOL zero-denominator behavior unspecified; its PositionSize operands at :573-577 have no declared common unit.
RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:240-250 correctly specifies CLV and BodyEfficiency zero-range handling, demonstrating the missing equivalent boundaries for ER and RVOL at :206-238.

RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:100-130 requires versioned availability and abstention; measurement-contract global_rules requires pure pre-cutoff observables and no antecedent/outcome overlap; CORE_TRADING_THEORY_v2_1.md:1180 and :1197-1219 enforce ordered path/evidence events and fail-closed unknowns.

Queue cross-reference closure is complete: every hypothesis has a measurement contract and every contract resolves to a queue hypothesis. However, hard falsifiers and expiry rules are prose fields, for example H-SHOCK-SQUEEZE-FAIL-01 and H-DYNAMIC-RISK-01, so their numeric/window predicates are not yet independently executable.

Parameter registry records source type and low/base/high sensitivity for all registry rows, but RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:402-420 introduces PriorOrdinal_h, w_h_g and tau_g as score/decay controls without a complete ID-bound registry mapping for the first two. Core v2.1 instead requires a frozen group aggregator at :1201-1207.

The object dictionary separates FACT through ACTION/RESULT and imposes no direct order authorization below PERMISSION; RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:732-749 defines module inputs, outputs and fail states.

The challenger requires a finite path pool with OTHER/UNKNOWN at :350-386; CORE_TRADING_THEORY_v2_1.md:1217-1219 further requires a proof-bound mutually exclusive and exhaustive normalized set with OTHER_PATH residual, otherwise UNKNOWN_NO_VALID_COMPETITION_SET.

RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:388-433 limits E0 score to ordinal ranking and requires calibration before probability; CORE_TRADING_THEORY_v2_1.md:1197-1233 separately forbids primitive-score normalization and restricts numeric scenarios to synthetic counterfactual arithmetic.

The object dictionary grants order authority only to separately governed PERMISSION; stage contract closes D0 through E3 pending a new Sol decision; CORE_TRADING_THEORY_v2_1.md:1235 restricts V5-M00 to DENY/UNKNOWN, ABSTAIN and max_risk=0.

RESEARCH_SYSTEM_THEORY_CHALLENGER_v1_0.md:717-728 requires a staged simple-to-complex order; :751-766 includes trend, range and no-trade baselines; the measurement contracts provide named comparators.

For object_dictionary, hypothesis_queue, measurement_contract, parameter_registry, source_authority_registry and stage_contract, the declared canonicalization lists a domain but omits the domain-prefix-plus-0x00 formula. Direct SHA-256(canonical JSON) fails; SHA-256(domain || 0x00 || canonical JSON) matches all six stored digests. The Sol decision declares this formula explicitly and passes direct reproduction.

findings.title: Registry and stage digest specifications are under-specified
findings.impact: An independent validator following only the stated fields cannot reproduce any of the six protected identities. This breaks the P0 acceptance requirement that canonical serialization and self-digest rules be independently recomputable, even though the intended inferred formula reproduces the stored hashes.
findings.minimal_fix: Add an explicit formula, domain_prefix_utf8 and domain_separator_hex=00 to each canonicalization record, then require validators to use that declared formula; do not change content merely to conceal the present mismatch.
findings.discriminating_test: For each artifact, recompute after blanking/excluding its digest using exactly the declared formula; mutate the domain, separator, an array order and one non-digest field, and require rejection in all four cases.

findings.title: Core direction and relative-volume measures lack total arithmetic boundaries
findings.impact: A flat close path makes ER 0/0; a zero-median volume window makes RVOL undefined or infinite. Different implementations can emit NaN, zero, infinity or an exception, changing state and hypothesis eligibility despite the object dictionary's UNKNOWN requirement.
findings.minimal_fix: State in the measurement contract that ER denominator=0 and RVOL median<=0 return UNKNOWN (and that any non-finite input returns UNKNOWN); bind the exact affected data-quality reason code.
findings.discriminating_test: Use synthetic all-equal closes, all-zero prior volume, one zero-volume bar and non-finite/missing inputs. Every case must produce the same typed UNKNOWN and must not update a score, state, path or permission.

findings.title: Two action-size formulas create an unresolved authority and unit conflict
findings.impact: The challenger formula omits worst cost and tail from the risk denominator and compares unlabeled cap quantities. The core formula includes cost/tail per unit and named quantity caps. A future implementer could select either formula or compare incompatible quantities.
findings.minimal_fix: Mark the challenger formula as superseded/non-authoritative for action geometry and reference the core q contract, or version a single replacement with every operand dimensioned as currency, R, price per unit or quantity.
findings.discriminating_test: A static dimensional checker must reject any min operand not expressed in executable quantity units and must prove that increasing cost_worst_per_unit or tail_per_unit never increases q.

findings.title: Ordinal-score controls are not fully registry-bound
findings.impact: PriorOrdinal_h and w_h_g may be chosen outside source-type, range, sensitivity and chronology controls. This permits hidden tuning even when the listed parameter registry is frozen.
findings.minimal_fix: Either prohibit weighted ranking in the challenger until a versioned aggregator contract exists, or register every prior/weight/decay control with domain, source type, low/base/high plan, update condition and dependency-group semantics; bind the score formula to those IDs.
findings.discriminating_test: Reject an evidence update when its prior, weight, aggregator or decay parameter is absent from the frozen parameter registry, outside its declared domain, or changed after chronology freeze.

findings.title: Falsifiers and expiries are present but not yet machine-distinguishable
findings.impact: The queue is conceptually falsifiable, but prose such as accepted transition, stable increment and maximum duration does not bind a feature version, threshold, window, label or censoring rule. Independent implementations can reach different terminal states from identical facts.
findings.minimal_fix: Before D3/E2, replace each testable hard_falsifier and expiry prose rule with a referenced predicate schema containing observable IDs, comparator, threshold/interval, clock, horizon, censoring and terminal enum; retain prose only as explanation.
findings.discriminating_test: For every active hypothesis, evaluate positive, soft-contradiction, hard-falsifier, expiry and gap fixtures twice through independent predicate implementations and require identical terminal labels.

unresolved_risks: No market, replay, calibration or holdout evidence was reviewed; this review cannot assess predictive validity, economic value, execution realism or source coverage.

The LCB_U expression in CORE_TRADING_THEORY_v2_1.md:1225-1233 is a deterministic conservative utility adjustment, not a statistical lower confidence bound until an estimator, confidence level and sampling procedure are separately specified.
Future normalized path probabilities remain conditional on a valid partition proof and independent calibration; no such empirical proof was assessed here.
maximum_positive_conclusion: The reviewed package has a coherent E0 research architecture: it separates facts, measurements, beliefs, paths, scenarios, utility, permission and action; it fails closed on PIT/quality uncertainty; it retains competing alternatives and simple baselines; and its current permission route cannot self-authorize data acquisition, backtesting, paper trading or live risk. These are design and contract strengths only, not evidence of market validity, calibrated probabilities, profitability or operational readiness.
